digest.component_or_area: outbound differ / reconciler vendor adapter seam
propositions: The outbound differ compares fields in vendor (Jira) shape while the inbound differ compares in canonical (local) shape, creating an asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 section (d) and blocks epic bbf1 AC3.

The outbound differ must canonicalize the remote snapshot via the injected InboundMapper before comparison and emit vendor payloads exclusively via the injected OutboundMapper at the emission boundary, mirroring the inbound differ's approach.

The InboundMapper output must expand to include three new canonical alias keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) with fixed shapes for identity matching, parent reference, and reporter tracking, guard emitted keys on vendor-source presence, and tolerate partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets.

The OutboundMapper must gain map_fields_to_remote(local_fields) to translate only changed local field names/values to vendor shape at emission, and resolve_assignee(local_value, remote_identity) to return (payload_value, authoritative, is_account_id) preserving the accountId fast-path and unmappable-to-unassign soft-fail behavior.

The outbound differ must replace vendor-specific comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) with neutral canonical-field comparison logic expressed on local field names, relocating helpers to adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py (adapter-internal).

All field, label, baseline, and description comparisons in the update path must operate on canonical shapes after inbound mapping; the stored baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest (opaque, no migration) and is canonicalized at read time in the outbound differ's suppression/conflict path.
